$comment: Hand fixes applied on top of the OSM import (PLAN.md §4.1). Survives re-imports: refer to OSM ids and coordinates, never to generated segment ids. osm.includeWays/excludeWays: OSM way ids to force in/out of the in-service network (applied by import-osm). turns.add/remove: {node: [lon, lat], a: [lon, lat], b: [lon, lat], note} — at the node nearest `node` (≤5 m), allow/forbid passing between the incident tracks nearest `a` and `b`. platforms: {stop: GTFS stop_name, near: [lon, lat], note} pins that stop to the track nearest `near`. addTrack: optional GeoJSON of track missing from OSM (joined to existing track within 4 m of its endpoints). patternPlatforms: role-based pins — for patterns that start/end at (or pass through) a station, use the track nearest each given point at the listed stations (for temporary operations GTFS platform numbers don't describe).

osm.$excludeWaysNote: Braid–Lougheed Expo track closed until ~2027 for the OMC4 flyover works (confirmed by Braden, 2026-09-26); the other track is single-tracked. OPEN-QUESTIONS #17.

platforms.note: GTFS coordinate lies on the scissors crossover ~100 m south of the platform; pinned to the northbound stub (OSM way 923508922) 35 m from the buffer stop.
As P5: pinned to the other stub (OSM way 923508923) 35 m from the buffer stop.

patternPlatforms.note: OMC4 works (Feb 2024–~2027): Braid short-turns use the west track, dead-ended just north of Braid (Platform 2 per TransLink), running in both directions between Braid and the crossover south of Sapperton. Satellite imagery 2026 shows no crossover near Braid (Braden, 2026-09-26).
Trains to/from Lougheed and Production Way–University use the east track in both directions (single-track north of Braid; Platform 1 per TransLink).
